hebrewText: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָ/ם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֣ם מִ/דָּ֑ם וּֽ/בַל אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗/ם עַל שְׂפָתָֽ/י

tokens.kjv: (bring in) abundance ([idiom] -antly), [phrase] archer (by mistake for H7232 (רָבַב)), be in authority, bring up, [idiom] continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding(-ly), be full of, (be, make) great(-er, -ly, [idiom] -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty(-eous), [idiom] process (of time), sore, store, thoroughly, very.

tokens.bdb: a idol; also, a pain or wound
properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.
properly, to be liquid or flow easily, i.e. (by implication); to hurry (in a good or a bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially, promptly
tokens.kjv: be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste(-n, -ily), (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) [idiom] quickly, rash, [idiom] shortly, (be so) [idiom] soon, make speed, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] straightway, [idiom] suddenly, swift.

tokens.bdb: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
tokens.kjv: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

tokens.bdb: to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking
tokens.kjv: cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

tokens.bdb: a libation; also a cast idol

tokens.enLiteralWord: a libation; also a cast idol
tokens.explanation: a libation; also a cast idol

tokens.explanation: blood  of man or an animal; by analogy

tokens.bdb: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
tokens.kjv: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

tokens.bdb: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
tokens.kjv: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
tokens.kjv: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.
